claims.statement: Village life at Skara Brae: approximately 3100–2500 BCE.
Skara Brae’s stone houses preserve hearths, beds and storage furniture. The inhabitants farmed, hunted and fished and made tools, pottery and jewellery.
Skara Brae site reference. This is a reference position, not a territorial boundary.

evidence.note: Approximate occupation dates follow Historic Scotland’s management plan. The reason village life ended is uncertain.
